instruction.text: Past perfect progressive oder simple past? Schreibe die richtige Zeitform in die Lücke.
instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>past perfect progressive</voice> oder <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>simple past</voice> Schreibe die richtige Zeitform in die Lücke.

hint.text:
Das past perfect progressive wird folgendermaßen gebildet:
had + been + Verb-ing.
hint.sound: Das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>past perfect progressive</voice> wird folgendermaßen gebildet <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>had</voice> plus <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>been</voice> plus Verb mit ing.

atoms.b: Finley ((had_been_painting)) the walls since 9 a.m. when his partner took over.
Francis ((had_been_dancing)) since 4 p.m. before he was interrupted by a phone call.
My cousin Wyatt ((had_been_selling)) computers for five years before he started his own business.
Riley's cat ((played)) with its toy ten minutes ago.
Blanca ((had_been_writing)) short stories for two years before she wrote her first book.
My friend Madison slept well after she ((had_been_cleaning)) her room for hours.
